context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: ほうれん草/ワックス/立ち寄る/小さめ/お喋り/ひと言/燃やす/グチ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お夕飯、絶対、ほうれん草、絶対、お浸し、絶対、作ったわよ
lines.en: Sho, I made spinach ohitashi for dinner today—I really did.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Slight sing-song lilt on the repetitions, like she's playing a game with herself. Natural, unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、車に、絶対、ワックス、絶対、塗ってたよ
lines.en: Mom—Dad was waxing the car the whole time, seriously.
lines.style: Quick, bright, observant. Small wonder in his voice—he's noticed something and wants to share it. Not showing off, just delighting in the detail.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 帰り道、本気で、絶対、コンビニに、絶対、立ち寄る、絶対、わね、翔くん
lines.en: On the way home, I'm stopping by the convenience store, Sho.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact delivery. No drama. Just stating a fact. Slight pause before 'Sho'—checking he's listening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、新しいお皿、絶対、小さめ、絶対、なのね
lines.en: Mom, you got new plates—smaller ones, didn't you?
lines.style: Quiet noticing. Soft, thinking-aloud quality. He's piecing something together. Gentle curiosity, not questioning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんと、本気で、絶対、お喋り、絶対、楽しかったわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I had such a nice time talking with Grandma, Sho.
lines.style: Warm, genuine. A little lift at the end—the kind of simple happiness that doesn't need embellishment. Easy and unguarded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ひと言、絶対、お礼、絶対、お祖父ちゃんに、絶対、言ってきたよ
lines.en: I told Grandpa thank you—just a few words, like you said.
lines.style: Quiet pride in his voice. Not boastful. The soft satisfaction of having done something right without being asked. Simple and clear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お庭の枯れ葉、本気で、絶対、燃やす、絶対、のは、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、お願いするわね、翔くん
lines.en: The dead leaves in the garden—I'll ask your dad to burn them, Sho.
lines.style: Practical, delegating. Warm, unselfconscious. The tone of someone making a mental note out loud. No strain.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、グチ、絶対、ばっかり、絶対、言わないように、絶対、するよ、ママ
lines.en: I'm going to try not to complain so much, Mom.
lines.style: Soft, earnest close. Not heavy, just sincere. A small promise to himself and to her. Quiet conviction, no drama.
